name: taskplane
description: AI software-delivery control plane for Claude and Codex: simple build, review, and status prompts backed by dependency-aware readiness, scoped execution, fingerprinted evidence, 25-lens review, and human approval.

interface.longDescription: taskplane is the AI software-delivery control plane for heavy users who build and review code with Claude or Codex every day. Ask simply to build, review, or show status while a strict execution harness stays behind the scenes. Definition of Ready blocks under-specified or dependency-ambiguous work; scoped contracts constrain execution; workers submit fingerprinted evidence for orchestrator-only Definition-of-Done gates; and a full 25-lens engineering review exposes architecture, security, operability, data, UX, and other technical consequences for technical and nontechnical decision-makers. Requirements, contracts, planned modules, and realized dependency impact stay connected, with distributed-system review bounded at explicit contracts between entities.
capabilities: Enforce Definition of Ready before implementation begins
Constrain execution to an approved task scope
Require evidence-backed Definition of Done before sign-off
Gate dependency and contract impact at Ready and Done
Separate worker submissions from orchestrator validation
Publish progress artifacts for team handoff
defaultPrompt: taskplane build this feature and ask me only for material decisions.
taskplane review this branch without changing code.
taskplane status: tell me what is happening and whether you need me.
